data.title: Expect significant economic fallout if the AI boom falters: Economist
data.description: Constance Hunter, Chief Economist and Head of Research at Economist Enterprise, says AI-related exports are buoying Asian economies, while AI-driven equity gains are supporting U.S. consumption. She warns that the concentration of growth leaves economies exposed if the AI boom falters.
